description: Angular component for a color input UI element with color picker integration, supporting various input options and validation.

classes.name: ColorInputComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for a customizable color input with color picker dialog and popover support.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates the color control validators based on 'required' property.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current color value programmatically.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: showColorPicker
methods.description: Opens color picker dialog and updates value based on user selection.

methods.name: openColorPickerPopup
methods.description: Displays color picker as a popover and handles color selection.
